# Version 3.119.4
> **Servicing stability release** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 rolls forward the 3.119 servicing line with platform fixes and bundled dependency updates. It incorporates the unreleased 3.119.3 preview work, including Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time reliability improvements.

## Breaking Changes

- **Blazor API compatibility changes** — The Blazor API diff contains breaking changes in this servicing line. Rebuild Blazor applications against 3.119.4 and update any code that no longer compiles against the revised view surface.

## Bug Fixes

- **3.119 platform reliability fixes consolidated** — Rolls the Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time runtime fixes from the preview line into the stable servicing release. ([#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485), [#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494))

## Security

- **Bundled image library refreshed** — Updates the libpng dependency used by the packaged native assets. ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

Updates HarfBuzzSharp with the binding and native dependency changes included in the 3.119.4 servicing line.
